{"consolidated_memory":"Two separate malformed record incidents in ingest/pipeline/parser.py, both resolved in March 2026:

**Incident 1: Non-ASCII Name Handling [2026-03-02]**
- Component: ingest/pipeline/parser.py (ingest side)
- Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Repro: mixed-encoding sample file
- Root cause: config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Signal: decode error pointing at one byte offset
- Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 47 days running
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR: #1670, branch: fix/malformed-record-1

**Incident 2: Midnight Boundary Job Scheduling [2026-03-21]**
- Component: ingest/pipeline/parser.py (ingest side)
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Repro: mixed-encoding sample file
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware one
- Signal: decode error pointing at one byte offset
- Result: 49 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR: #9801, branch: fix/malformed-record-2

Both incidents occurred in the same corner of ingest/pipeline/parser.py with prior related malformed record work providing context."}
